description:
Save a named camera viewpoint in the project (res://.summer/camera_bookmarks.json): position and look_at as Vector3 literals, or neither to take the editor's 3D camera. The scene file is not touched. Next: summer_screenshot.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/camera-bookmark"}

fov.description: save only. Vertical field of view in degrees (1..179, default 60). With a captured viewport pose the viewport camera's fov wins.

look_at.description: save only. Point the camera looks at, e.g. "Vector3(0, 1, 0)". Must differ from position.

name.description: Bookmark name for save/delete: 1-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - (e.g. "hero_closeup").

position.description: save only. Camera position as a Godot literal, e.g. "Vector3(0, 5, 12)". Goes together with look_at; omit BOTH to capture the current editor 3D viewport camera.

name: summer_engine_save_camera_bookmark
title: Save a camera bookmark
